_note: 4권(마법 성) 새 대본. 유닛 = 독립 4컷, 컷당 한 문장(긴 모음 단어 + 사이트워드). 요정 이(Fairy E)는 손바닥만 한 요정 친구로만. {FAIRY} {BEADS} 사용 가능.
setting: A frame from a 3D animated film set in a friendly storybook castle garden: a small round stone castle with a blue roof, a courtyard with a fountain, flower beds and a low wall, calm plain sky, soft lighting, limited palette of lavender, gold, mint and sky blue.

panels.desc: {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} walk up a path to a small round castle with a blue roof; the gate stands open.
{FAIRY}, a palm-sized fairy, peeks out from a flower in the courtyard and giggles; {PIP} flutters closer.
{FAIRY} taps a flower with her wand and it turns into a big rose; {BUN} and {HED} gasp.
{FAIRY} sits on {PIP}'s head like a tiny hat; {PIP} crosses its eyes to look up; {BUN} and {HED} laugh.
In the courtyard {BUN} wears a small cap; {FAIRY} hovers with her wand; a cake sits on a table by the gate.
{FAIRY} taps the cap with her wand; it turns into a long red cape on Bun's back; {HED} claps.
{snake} slides up wearing the cape it has taken; {BUN} chases it around the fountain; a weather vane spins.
{snake} and {BUN} share the cape, both wrapped in it; {PIP} laughs; a wave splashes in the fountain. A cane leans on the wall.
panels.text: A cape for a snake and Bun!

panels.desc: {HED} flies a kite in the castle garden; the kite's string tangles in a tall pine tree; {PIP} and {BUN} point up.
panels.text: The kite is in the pine.

panels.desc: {BUN} rides a bike round the pine, trying to pull the string; a beehive hangs on a branch; {HED} worries.
{FAIRY} taps the pine; the kite slides down the trunk by itself; five ripe pine cones fall.
The kite lands on {PIP}'s head; {PIP} hides under it; {BUN} and {HED} dive to catch it; nine cones roll around.
A folded note hangs from a rope that goes up to the castle tower; {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} look up. A stone and a cone sit by the wall.
{HED} pulls the rope; a bone slides down it; {dog} appears at the top wagging. {BUN} laughs.
{dog} in a little robe slides down the rope to the garden, holding a rose in its mouth; a globe sits on the wall.
{PIP} reads the blank note (no writing) and points home; the dog follows them with the rose on its nose.
{mule} stands in the courtyard looking sad, with a huge load of cubes on its back; {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} look.
panels.text: The mule has a huge load.

panels.desc: {BUN} plays a flute; {mule} starts to tap its hoof; the cubes bounce; a tube rolls off.
{FAIRY} taps the cubes; they fly off like bubbles over the sand dune; {mule} kicks up its heels.
{mule} dances with a plume feather on its head; {PIP} plays the flute badly; everyone laughs.
panels.text: In June, we use the flute!

panels.desc: {FAIRY} holds a tiny card for {PIP} in the courtyard; {BUN} and {HED} watch; a cap lies on the table.
panels.text: Fairy E has a magic card.

panels.desc: {FAIRY} taps the cap with her wand; it becomes a cape again; {PIP} watches very closely.
{PIP} taps a kit box with its wing; it turns into a kite; {PIP} jumps with joy.
panels.text: Kit... kite! I can make it!

panels.desc: {snake}, {mule}, {BUN}, {HED} and {FAIRY} cheer around {PIP} who holds the kite.
Rain falls on a small garden train on a track around the castle; {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} wait with a tray of hay.
{jay} flies down and lands on the train's roof, shaking off water; its tail feathers drip. {HED} holds a nail and a sail.
{BUN} paints the train bright red with a brush; the rain washes the paint into puddles; clay dries on the wheels.
The sun comes out; the train chugs around the track carrying {PIP} and {jay}; a rainbow arches behind the castle.
panels.text: No rain. We play on the train!

panels.desc: A big tree in the castle garden; {bee} buzzes around a flower; {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} have tea under the tree. A leaf and a seed lie on the grass.
{sheep} wanders in and eats the leaf; {HED} points at its feet, which are muddy.
{seal} slides in from the sea pool with a peach on its nose and offers it to {BUN}.
panels.text: Eat a peach? Thank you, seal!

panels.desc: Everyone shares the peach under the tree; {bee} sits on {PIP}'s head; {PIP} stays very still.
panels.text: A bee on me! I see it!

panels.desc: {goat} sits in a small wooden boat on the castle moat wearing a coat; {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} watch from the road. A bar of soap floats by.
{crow} lands on the boat's bow with a slice of toast; the goat tries to grab it; the boat rocks.
Snow begins to fall on the moat; the goat shivers in its coat; {HED} holds out a bowl of warm soup from a window.
{goat} and {crow} share the soup in the boat under falling snow; {PIP} rows the boat slowly with a spoon.
Night at the castle; a full moon; {mouse} sits on the roof looking at the moon; {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} look up from the courtyard. A broom leans on the wall.
panels.text: Look at the moon and the mouse.

panels.desc: {mouse} opens its mouth wide in a yawn showing one tooth; a boot sits on the roof next to it.
A cloud covers the moon; {mouse} scurries into a tiny house on the roof; {BUN} points.
{GRUMBLE} on a couch in the courtyard snores under the moon; {mouse} sleeps on his belly; {PIP} covers them with a leaf.
A round room in the castle tower with a window full of stars; {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} peek in; a jar of stars sits on a shelf; a harp stands in the corner.
panels.text: The star room is far up.

panels.desc: {BUN} plucks the harp; {HED} blows a horn; a storm of little stars swirls out of the jar.
Stars land on a toy car and a fork on the table; a cob of corn glows; {PIP} chases a star.
{FAIRY} waves her wand; the stars fly back into the jar; one star stays on {PIP}'s head like a crown; a torch lights the farm scene painted on the wall.
panels.text: One star is far, far better.

panels.desc: The castle courtyard lit with lanterns; {PIP}, {BUN}, {HED} and {FAIRY} set a table with a cake, a tray and a bowl.
Guests arrive: {snake} in a cape, {mule} with a flute, {goat} in a coat, {mouse} with a boot. {HED} waves.
{GRUMBLE} arrives riding the garden train, lantern in paw, half asleep; everyone laughs kindly.
Everyone dances under the stars; {FAIRY} makes the fountain glow; {GRUMBLE} dozes on the couch with {PIP} on his nose.
A stage in the castle courtyard with a velvet curtain; {PIP} wears a top hat; {FAIRY} sits on the hat.
{snake}, {goat} and {mouse} each hold a blank white card; {BUN} and {HED} present them with a bow.
{GRUMBLE} on stage holds a card and yawns so wide the card falls; {FAIRY} catches it with her wand.
Everyone on stage takes a bow together; confetti falls; {GRUMBLE} smiles widely and waves.
